svg.title: LLVMScope — overall layered architecture
svg.desc: Five-layer architecture: language frontends, LLVM IR ingestion, core engine, dual analysis pipelines, and output adapters

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How does Rust emit LLVM IR bitcode?')
sendPrompt('How does Zig emit LLVM IR?')
sendPrompt('How does Clang emit LLVM IR for C and C++?')
sendPrompt('Which other languages compile to LLVM IR?')

g.text: Bitcode parser · debug info extractor · symbol resolver · incremental cache
Comptime pass registration · inter-pass dependency resolver
Shared IR view (read-only) · diagnostic aggregator · config loader

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What does the CFG/DFG pass detect?')
sendPrompt('What does alias analysis detect in LLVMScope?')
sendPrompt('What is type-state analysis and what bugs does it catch?')
sendPrompt('How does lock order analysis detect potential deadlocks?')
sendPrompt('How does the LLVM pass inject instrumentation probes?')
sendPrompt('How does the runtime event collector work?')
sendPrompt('How does the wait-for graph detect live deadlocks?')
sendPrompt('What does shadow memory track at runtime?')

g.text: Plugin host (Zig comptime + C ABI dlopen)
Static checker plugins · runtime detector plugins · language-specific rule packs
Diagnostic bus · dedup · severity filter · source-map resolver
